name: Shareholder agreements

subjectOf.text: The 1991 passage of Section 7.32 of the Model Business Corporation Act triggered a wave of state authorization of shareholder control agreements, adopted specifically to secure the validity of such agreements rather than leaving validity to uncertain judicial development.
subjectOf.abstract: Since Section 7.32 of the Model Business Corporation Act (MBCA) was passed in 1991, most US states have authorized shareholder control agreements in an effort to support the validity of such agreements.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612

subjectOf.text: Although shareholder agreements are authorized and shaped by corporation code provisions, their construction is governed by ordinary contract interpretation rules, so statutory authorization does not displace contract doctrine.
subjectOf.abstract: While the agreements are governed by legislation, general rules applicable to contract interpretation govern the construction of shareholder agreements.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612
scope_conditions: United States, Delaware law illustrated by Salamone v. Gorman

subjectOf.text: Shareholder agreement terms that limit board authority are vulnerable to invalidation, and the dominant judicial rationale is that such agreements tie the hands of directors and make it impossible for them to exercise discretion over the matters the agreement settles.
subjectOf.abstract: Courts offer varying rationales for nullifying terms of shareholder agreements that limit the board's authority, but most often, courts worry the agreements "tie the hands of the directors," making it impossible for them to exercise their discretion concerning matters decided in the agreement.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612
scope_conditions: provisions that encroach on the directors' statutory authority to manage the business and affairs of the corporation

subjectOf.text: Courts are split on whether a corporation is bound by a shareholder agreement it did not sign: some hold the corporation bound where all shareholders are parties to a valid agreement, while others refuse to bind it.
subjectOf.abstract: Additionally, if all shareholders of a corporation are parties to a valid agreement, courts have held the corporation bound by the agreement even if it is not formally a party to it.46 Other courts have not found the corporation to be bound.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612
scope_conditions: all shareholders are parties to the agreement
corporation is not formally a party
